wiki.title: Mark Gonzalez (politician)
wiki.extract: Mark J. Gonzalez is an American politician who is currently a member of the California State Assembly since 2024. Prior to his election to the State Assembly, he was the chair of the Los Angeles County Democratic Party and was a Presidential elector.
